# Matheus Salmi (full)

> Software Architect & Tech Lead at StartCHURCH (US), working remotely from Brazil. He designs systems end to end: how they’re built and scale, what they cost and return, and how AI helps them do more and know more.

Matheus has been building software professionally since 2007. Since 2018 he has owned the architecture and operation of StartCHURCH’s platform (billing, CRM integration, sites and admin tools) across infrastructure, backend, data and front end.

His work is organized around three areas (anonymous outcomes for each are on https://msalmi.com/work/):

- **Engineering:** systems and teams that outlast him: documented, shared and handed over. Re-platformed infrastructure to AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, modernized the framework stack, made deploys zero-downtime, and gave dev, staging and production the same images.
- **Business:** tradeoffs explained in numbers, to engineers and to the CFO. Runs the cloud cost program, keeps billing and payments reliable, and automates manual work.
- **AI:** LLMs in the product, agents for the team, shipped rather than demoed. Built a self-hosted MCP server giving the team read-only, AI-assisted access to production data, and brought agents and Claude Code reviews into daily work.

Contact: mathsalmi@gmail.com.

## Experience

### StartCHURCH (US) — Software Architect & Tech Lead

Jul 2018 – present · remote

Products: startchurch.com, Admin Console, StartSITES, Kingdom Steward, StartCHURCH University, Video Platform, AppletBuilder, Giving Halo, Launch Halo and the Attorney Network. Contracted via Scalable Path until May 2022, then hired directly.

**Architecture & platform**

- Own the architecture and day-to-day operation of every product above.
- Re-platformed everything over several years, alongside product work: DigitalOcean → AWS, Ansible and Vagrant → Docker and Kubernetes, Bitbucket → GitHub with CI and tests on every push.
- Split a single all-or-nothing deploy into independent apps that scale horizontally and deploy with zero downtime; dev, staging and production run the exact same images.
- Upgraded the core stack from Symfony 3.4 to 6.4 and PHP 8.3, and legacy views to React and TypeScript; ported Kingdom Steward and StartCHURCH University from Zend to Symfony 6 with Claude Code (rolling out).
- Built sc, the team’s CLI: one command sets up a dev machine on macOS, Linux or Windows and standardizes daily work.
- Co-designed a microservices platform prototype with single sign-on (Keycloak) across legacy and current Symfony apps and Next.js frontends (2020–2021).

**Business**

- Run the cloud cost program: refactored code, restructured infrastructure and right-sized every service.
- Built a two-way HubSpot CRM sync and migrated about 20 years of operational data, millions of records, keeping sales and finance on one source of truth.
- Keep billing and payments reliable and automate the billing team’s manual work.
- Rebuilt the admin console for mobile and accessibility, letting sales close invoices from their phones.
- Took over Giving Halo and Launch Halo to keep them running: release-based deploys, tests on every PR, daily database backups.
- Built and maintained the Attorney Network’s console and APIs until the product was retired; modernized AppletBuilder; moved the Video Platform to its own Next.js app.

**AI**

- Built a self-hosted MCP server giving the team read-only, AI-assisted access to production data through Claude, keeping the data in-house.
- Brought agents and Claude Code reviews into the team’s daily work.

**Leadership**

- Technical direction across five managers and a full turnover of the original team; recognized internally as the company’s architect.
- Onboard, review and mentor engineers, from bootcamp juniors to senior hires; advise on hiring profiles and interviews.

### Scalable Path (US) — Software Engineer

Jul 2017 – May 2022 · remote

- Embedded in US client teams: Tempo (Scalable Path’s showcase site), Timelinely, The Mission Zone and StartCHURCH.
- Built The Mission Zone’s MVP single-handedly, mentoring a junior developer along the way (2018–2019).
- Placed with StartCHURCH, which hired me directly in 2022.

### Instituto Euvaldo Lodi (IEL-GO) — Technical Architect

Aug 2014 – Jul 2017 · Goiânia, Brazil

Industry Federation of Goiás (FIEG) organization for corporate management, entrepreneurial education and careers.

- Started as senior engineer on ten Java systems already in production; improved them iteratively instead of rewriting them, and became the bridge between development, infrastructure and business.
- Moved the systems to Linux on AWS and hardened SQL Server; designed a new microservices architecture (Java, Spring Boot, SQL Server, messaging and queues) and built on it the accounting data sync (payables, receivables) between IEL-GO and FIEG (Casa da Indústria); also the internship program website.

### Squadra Tecnologia — Software Engineer

Oct 2012 – Jul 2014 · Anápolis, Brazil

- Systems for Brazilian federal agencies: SIMEC (Ministry of Education), IPHAN (national heritage institute) and DNPM (national mining department), in PHP / Zend and Oracle, Java and .NET.
- A cross-platform quiz app for iOS and Android.

### IIDAC — Web Developer

Jul 2007 – Oct 2012 · Anápolis, Brazil

- First job: web applications for social programs of a UN-partner NGO, reaching young people across Brazil: ODM Universidades, Voz dos Adolescentes, Rejupe, PPCAAM (federal program, Human Rights Secretariat) and the IIDAC website.
- Worked alongside UN Volunteers from five countries.
